customer_message.body:
Hello

While the sequence is unclear: Two weeks after I reported the damp wall in writing, I received a termination for own use; It had never been mentioned before; this is how I remember it.

Regarding “potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights”, for this message: the landlord motive remains unresolved; for the request “preserve the deadline and review the motive and chronology”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the own use evidence; that is what I know today.

I now need: preserve the deadline and review the motive and chronology; in particular, I need clarity about the own use evidence and which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; Please clarify the landlord motive; I do not want to act before this is clear.

I became aware of the problem on 23 May 2025.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Chronology still unclear: potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights
